description.value: Pizza Pizza is a Canadian pizza chain established in 1967, offering dine-in, takeout, and delivery from this Abbotsford location on South Fraser Way. The menu spans pizzas with multiple crust options, chicken wings, poutine, panzerottis, and strombolis, alongside dairy-free, vegan, and gluten-free options. This location is A-Level Certified and is noted as open late, making it a practical stop for cyclists finishing a long day on the road.
